# Template PDFs for testing Monograph PDF

Professional-looking, fully fictional PDFs, one or more per kind of test. They are generated by `make_templates.py`
(PyMuPDF only, no personal data) into `pdf/`, described by `manifest.json`, and checked by
`tests/integration/test_templates.py`.

Regenerate: `env\Scripts\python.exe tests\fixtures\templates\make_templates.py`

| File | Use it for |
|---|---|
| `invoice_a4` | tables, Excel export, text editing, print |
| `business_report` | bookmarks, navigation, Word conversion, page operations, charts |
| `scientific_paper_two_column` | selection across columns, highlighting, symbols, figures |
| `application_form_acroform` | text/combo/list/radio/checkbox/signature fields, flatten |
| `contract_unsigned_signature_fields` | signature fields (no cryptographic signature) |
| `japanese_notice`, `bilingual_en_ja_letter` | CJK text, embedded fonts, mixed language, OCR |
| `account_statement_tables` | table extraction, negative numbers |
| `brochure_landscape` | landscape, images, PowerPoint export |
| `scanned_memo_300dpi`, `scanned_memo_noisy_skewed` | OCR on clean and degraded scans |
| `mixed_sizes_and_rotations` | A4/Letter/A3/A5, rotation 90/180/270 |
| `annotated_review_copy` | every common annotation type |
| `highlight_playground` | highlighting over text, blank areas, images, tables, charts, dark fields |
| `transparency_overlap`, `image_heavy`, `fonts_specimen`, `newsletter_two_column` | rendering, images, fonts, text flow |
| `long_document_200_pages` | performance, memory, rotation speed |
| `empty_page`, `cropbox_offset` | edge cases and geometry |
| `slide_deck_mixed_aspect` | PDF to PowerPoint page-size groups (16:9 deck with one 4:3 slide), thumbnails, print scaling |
| `lab_protocol_figures_tables` | numbered protocol, reagent table, micrograph figure, landscape results table (Word/Excel export, highlighting, mixed orientation) |
| `photo_album_compression` | Compress PDF and target sizes on large photo-like JPEGs |
| `poster_a1_large_format` | very large page: zoom, tiles, printing to A4/A3, compression |
| `review_comment_threads` | Comments panel: several authors, a reply thread, every text-markup type, sticky note, free text |
| `password_protected_aes256` | password prompt (password in `manifest.json`) |
| `permissions_restricted` | owner-restricted copy/edit |
| `damaged_truncated` | error handling: must be refused or repaired, never crash |

## Using your own PDFs from the Downloads folder

```
env\Scripts\python.exe scripts\check_pdfs.py            # every PDF in your Downloads folder
env\Scripts\python.exe scripts\check_pdfs.py <folder>   # any other folder
```

Each file is opened from a temporary copy (pages, encryption, scan detection, form fields, render, rotate + save
round trip); originals are never modified, which the script verifies by hash. `test_downloads_pdfs_open_and_originals_untouched`
runs the same check under pytest and skips when Downloads has no PDFs. The real-PDF tests read from Downloads or from
the folder named by `MONOGRAPH_PDF_REAL_PDF_DIR`. Private PDFs are never copied into the repository.
